drivers.name: Price increase (4.1%)
drivers.evidence: Same price in 2026-09-28: sales x0.91 vs baseline. Past promotions show weak noise-adjusted lift (x1.03), suggesting limited sensitivity. One prior price rise observed, no promotion. Shrink effect due to thin evidence.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 29.7. The price increased 4.1% to $13.93, which is above regular price. Past promotions show a median noise-adjusted lift of x1.03, but this is a price increase, not a discount. Price hikes typically reduce demand; the 2026-09-28 week (same price, no promotion) sold 27 units (x0.91 vs baseline), indicating a negative price sensitivity. No event or promotion is planned. The classical model suggests no uplift, consistent with no known driver. Evidence for price sensitivity is weak (one prior price rise, no promotion), so shrink effect toward 1.0. No seasonal ramp or trend in recent weeks. Adjust down slightly for price increase.
